patches.summary: Every dump and mirror run emits exactly one machine-readable run report (stderr or --report-file) with rows_emitted, requests_made, rate_limit_hits, clean_exit and next_cursor; partial failures exit non-zero with next_cursor = last chunk boundary completed for all domains.
patches.reason: Warehouse ingest spec F1: the sync spine advances its watermark from next_cursor, never from the requested window. Includes a 4-line touch to generated internal/client/client.go adding request/429 counters (accessor in hand-authored metrics.go).
patches.validated_outcome: Kill-mid-chunk simulation reports the last fully-completed boundary; live dump keyword-ranks --report-file verified 2026-07-07.

patches.summary: dump now covers keywords, competitors, competitor-ranks, landing-pages and tags alongside keyword-ranks and domain-history, with one uniform --domain/--from/--to/--envelope/report contract.
patches.reason: Warehouse ingest spec F2: every ingest stream needs the same envelope/report semantics; competitors + keyword_competitor_ranks were modelled in model.yaml but unwired. Live-API drift handled: landing_pages list returns 'path' (aliased to landing_page), tags list prepends an untagged {tag:null} bucket row (dropped).
patches.validated_outcome: dump competitors rows round-trip into the model-generated accuranker_competitors SQLite table with no schema edits (verified live 2026-07-07, 3 rows); competitor-ranks emitted 2871 rows over a 3-day window with keyword_id/competitor_id/search_date stamped.

patches.summary: --envelope on every dump resource wraps each record as {source, endpoint, params_hash, api_version, fetched_at, payload} for lossless raw-JSONB landing.
patches.reason: Warehouse ingest spec F3: typed NDJSON is a convenience projection; the envelope is what the raw landing layer ingests so a model.yaml gap can never become data loss.
patches.validated_outcome: params_hash is insertion-order independent and endpoint-scoped (unit tests); live envelope verified 2026-07-07.

patches.summary: keywords-diff --against <prev-snapshot.ndjson|mirror> emits NDJSON added/removed panel-membership events (keyword_id, keyword, observed_at, created_at).
patches.reason: Warehouse ingest spec F4: the API has no keyword-deletion signal; the warehouse synthesizes (keyword, tracked_from, tracked_to) from daily snapshots. 'removed' is the soft-delete signal; the CLI keeps no state.
patches.validated_outcome: Same-input diff emits nothing (live verified: 319 vs 319 keywords, 0 events); raw and enveloped snapshot lines both parse.

patches.summary: model.yaml gains per-resource grain/watermark keys and per-column descriptions; schema --format postgres-ddl --comments emits COMMENT ON TABLE/COLUMN; schema --catalog emits catalog.json (grain, upsert key, watermark column, timezone notes).
patches.reason: Warehouse ingest spec F5: the CLI owns the best structured description of this data — let it seed the catalog instead of a human re-typing it. The catalog reports the DDL-enforced upsert key (primary_key_constraint when declared, e.g. keyword_ranks includes is_initial).
patches.validated_outcome: 114 COMMENT ON statements emitted; catalog upsert_key for keyword_ranks is [keyword_id, search_date, is_initial].

patches.summary: dump now covers every model.yaml warehouse resource except sync_cursor: full-serp, search-volume-history, ai-search-volume-history, competitor-history, landing-page-history, tag-history, people-also-ask, plus the GLOBAL resources domains/accounts/groups (no --domain). `dump all` sweeps them through one code path; a central dumpResources registry drives help, validation, dedup and the sweep.
patches.reason: Warehouse ingest spec F9: the Noracle M3 adapter shells out to `dump <resource> --envelope --agent --report-file`, so every resource added to dump becomes landable with zero adapter code. History resources are projected from the list endpoints' inline history (landing_pages/tags carry history.* inline), removing the old store-aware limitation on landing-page-history. Global resources dump the whole set with no --domain; dump domains carries created_at (per-domain backfill floor).
patches.validated_outcome: dump --help + agent-context list all 20 resources with windowed/snapshot/global classification; schema --catalog covers all 21 model tables with no gaps; dedup keys unit-tested per resource; full build + cli/schema/client test packages green.

patches.summary: The LLM/AccuLLM tier (brands, prompts, prompt-results) is wired under dump but off by default: excluded from a `dump all` sweep unless --include-llm, and any gated resource (LLM tier + tag-history) degrades to exit code 45 with status skipped_unentitled instead of a hard failure. In a sweep the LLM resources are recorded skipped_unentitled and the sweep still exits 0 for the entitled resources.
patches.reason: Warehouse ingest spec F10: the account has no LLM plan today, but the tool must be warehouse-ready the day one is added without a rebuild. Exit 45 is a distinct 'not entitled to this tier' signal (vs authErr=4 'bad credentials') so the sync spine can skip-and-continue. isUnentitledErr covers the AccuLLM paywall bodies plus HTTP 403 / 400+access-denial (tag-history is tier-restricted on some accounts).
patches.validated_outcome: Unit tests: a gated resource whose fetch returns a paywall body maps to ExitCode 45 with report.status=skipped_unentitled; a non-entitlement failure (e.g. connection refused) stays a hard error; isUnentitledErr matches paywall/403 but not 500/network.

patches.summary: F6 initial ranks: dump keyword-ranks now projects initial_rank.* alongside ranks.* and emits the KeywordInitialRank baseline row with is_initial=true (regular rows flagged is_initial=false honestly); the dedup key includes is_initial so the baseline never collides with the same-day daily rank. F7 retention probe: dump <windowed> --probe-earliest binary-searches the earliest date with data per domain (100-day probe windows smooth crawl gaps) and reports it as earliest_available in the F1 report without streaming rows.
patches.reason: Warehouse ingest spec F11: every keyword's series needs a defined left edge, and the spine needs the retention floor as a backfill floor instead of guessing. The conservative probe floor is <= the true earliest date, which is exactly what a backfill floor wants.
patches.validated_outcome: Unit tests: two chunks returning the same baseline dedup to one is_initial=true row plus the daily rows; --probe-earliest finds a floor <= the seeded data start and streams no rows.

patches.summary: dump full-serp now sets the API-required `limit` param and fetches one calendar day at a time (period_from == period_to, limit=500) instead of a single unpaginated request over the whole window. The keywords endpoint returns HTTP 422 for any full_serp request missing limit/period_from/period_to and enforces a 500 keyword-day cap; limit=500 reduces that to <=500 keywords/day, which both tracked domains satisfy (nyta ~319, myrvann fewer), so it is one request per day with no keyword paging. Setting limit also switches the endpoint to its DRF-paginated {count,next,previous,results} envelope, so the case decodes results[] instead of a bare array. Each day is its own dumpBatch so the F3 --envelope params reflect the real per-day request.
patches.reason: The F9 full-serp branch shipped without limit and issued one unpaginated request, so `dump full-serp` returned HTTP 422 and keyword_full_serp was BLOCKED in the Noracle M3 spine (impl-plan-m3-accuranker.md). The consumer contract (--envelope/--report-file/next_cursor/dedup, 100-day auto-chunk) is unchanged; this is purely a CLI fix. Keyword paging past 500 keywords/day is intentionally out of scope (not needed for the current account).
patches.validated_outcome: Live 2026-07-21. Single day: dump full-serp --domain 295242 --from 2026-07-18 --to 2026-07-18 --envelope --agent -> exit 0, 319 rows, clean_exit:true, next_cursor 2026-07-18, no 422. Multi-day --from 2026-07-01 --to 2026-07-18 -> exit 0, 5742 rows = 18 days x 319, full per-day coverage, 0 dupes, one report clean_exit:true. Noracle adapter (m3-accuranker): bun src/adapters/accuranker/main.ts --store nyta --resource keyword_full_serp --from 2026-07-18 --to 2026-07-18 -> exit 0, 319 rows, one run-report JSON clean_exit:true. go build ./..., go vet ./internal/cli/, cli/client/schema test packages green.
